name: How to Check and Convert a PDF to PDF/A-2b
description: Check whether a PDF meets PDF/A-2b archival requirements and convert eligible files — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. The file is analyzed entirely in your browser.

step.name: Review the compliance report
step.text: PDFree checks for embedded fonts, encryption, interactive actions/JavaScript, and LZW-compressed streams — the structural requirements PDF/A-2b enforces.

step.name: Convert if compliant
step.text: If no blocking issues are found, click 'Convert to PDF/A-2b' to add the required ICC color profile and XMP metadata, then download the converted file.
